title: A morphism of algebraic spaces can be lifted to chosen presentations
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism a : F -> G of algebraic spaces over S and any surjective etale q : V -> G from a scheme, there exist a scheme U and a commutative diagram with p : U -> F surjective etale (source lines 2064-2081). The proof chooses a surjective etale W -> F, forms U = W x_G V - a scheme because G is an algebraic space - notes that U -> W is surjective etale by base change of q, and concludes that the composite U -> F is surjective etale by stability under composition.
